description: Fadnavis outlines Maharashtra’s fintech vision using Agentic AI, tokenisation and quantum technology, with plans for a blockchain-based land asset framework
body_lead: CM Fadnavis unveils Maharashtra’s fintech vision with Agentic AI, tokenisation and quantum technology Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis said the state is exploring Agentic AI, tokenisation and quantum technology to transform financial services and boost financial inclusion.
